episodes.title: Jesus... I Fell Asleep In The Office Washroom 😮‍💨 (हिंदी)
episodes.hook: Jesus... I fell asleep in the office washroom for ten minutes. I told my manager I was on a call. 😮‍💨
hook_flags: Emoji in the hook. On-screen text at hook size has room for words or for an emoji, not both.
notes: Beat 1 has no number and no name in it. Hooks without something checkable are the ones that get scrolled.
Beat(s) 9, 10 run past 4s. Either split the line or change what is on screen inside it. A static frame is where people leave.
Beats 1-3 have nothing concrete in them. Put a number, a name or a price in one of them.
Beats 10-12 have nothing concrete in them. Put a number, a name or a price in one of them.
No loop. The last beat shares no word with the hook, so the video ends flat. Echoing one word from beat 1 is the cheapest replay you get.
9.2s under target. Either add 22 words or shoot it short. Short is usually right.
